biocontainers.name: bioconductor-frenchfish
biocontainers.summary: Poisson Models for Quantifying DNA Copy-number from FISH Images of Tissue Sections

biotools.summary: FrenchFISH comprises a nuclear volume correction method coupled with two types of Poisson models: either a Poisson model for improved manual spot counting without the need for control probes; or a homogenous Poisson Point Process model for automated spot counting.
